title: EG&G engineer's account of an egg-shaped craft that could not be opened

tellings.quote: The senior EG&G engineer described to my great uncle that it was egg-shaped about the size of a SUV.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a senior engineer at EG&G, a US defense contractor, described to Michels's great uncle a craft shaped like an egg and about the size of an SUV, a large family car. As the story is titled, the craft could not be opened, which, if true, would mean a contractor held an unknown object it could not get inside.
